title: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
summary: Cast Crusader’s Mantle once per Short Rest.

fields.Cast: Action. Self-centred 30 ft aura, Concentration up to 10 turns. Your weapon attacks and those of allies within the aura deal +1d4 Radiant per attack.
fields.Base value: 630 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
